product_one_liner.value: ON3 Works provides AI-native technical recruitment, finding, vetting and shortlisting engineers, developers and IT specialists for companies hiring in the UK and Spain.
product_one_liner.notes: Company's about page describes its recruiting service and target employers.

pricing_page.notes: Public page lists its pricing tiers.

named_customers.notes: The cited company page identifies CGI as a notable client, but no second verifiable customer appears; only one customer name can be supported.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn company page reports an employee count of 14.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn company profile lists London as headquarters; the About page separately describes the company as remote and Mallorca-based.

founded_year.notes: Company states it was founded in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The Insights index contains hiring research, salary, recruiting-cost and industry content; it does not show multiple posts by engineers about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Homepage navigation and footer include FAQ, recruiting information and Insights, but no public product documentation, developer portal or help center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No careers page or job board with a current opening was located, so there is no evidence supporting either a live AI/ML role or a negative answer.

model_provider.notes: The AI recruiting page mentions a fine-tuned LLM but does not identify the model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The website footer/navigation has no trust or security page or certification badges, and the homepage does not name any of the listed certifications.

last_funding.notes: The company About page discusses its founders and business but does not report outside funding; no company-specific funding round was located.

raised_18mo.notes: No outside funding is reported on the company About page, and no funding announcement was found.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No careers page or public job board was found to establish current openings or their absence.

launched_6mo.notes: The Insights page is readable but does not provide dates for the listed items or establish the date of the latest product launch; therefore the 6-month window cannot be assessed reliably.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete company team page or dated leadership-change announcement/profile was found to verify leadership movements during the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No job posts, product docs or integrations page naming CRM or sales/marketing systems was found.
